displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that theism merits a comparative probability advantage only if one unified divine-reasons model compresses several otherwise independent features better than fully specified naturalistic rivals.

novelty.explanation: This repairs isolated simplicity claims by requiring equivalent rival specification and cumulative explanatory compression.

premises.text: The relevant comparison must hold descriptive detail constant and evaluate complete theistic and naturalistic models using common standards for prior complexity and evidential likelihood.

novelty.explanation: This incorporates Oppy's methodological objection into a strengthened version of Swinburne's framework.

premises.text: A single purposive principle can count as explanatory compression when independently motivated divine reasons jointly favor orderly laws, embodied agency, moral freedom, and conscious interaction.

novelty.explanation: This develops the transcript's divine-reasons claims into an explicit cross-domain compression proposal.

premises.text: The predicted outcome should be a broad value-defined class of embodied moral agents, not humans specifically, thereby reducing dependence on anthropocentric selection after observing ourselves.

novelty.explanation: This directly repairs the outcome-selection weakness exposed by the anthropocentrism objection.

premises.text: Fine-tuning evidence should be stated conditionally: under independently defensible families of simple laws and measures, robust scarcity of agent-permitting outcomes would favor a purposive model.

novelty.explanation: This replaces an undefined rarity claim with a conditional robustness requirement across defensible measures.

premises.text: Consciousness supports theism only if naturalistic rivals require additional psychophysical principles whose specification cost exceeds the intentional and axiological structure already included in the divine model.

novelty.explanation: This converts a contested nonidentity argument into a comparative complexity test between complete models.

conclusion.text: Therefore, if the unified divine-reasons model remains simpler under equivalent description and robustly raises the likelihood of order, embodied agency, and consciousness, theism receives a proportionate comparative advantage.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion limits the strengthened theistic case to the comparative conditions established by its premises.

newArguments.title: Robustness across evidence partitions
newArguments.text: A cumulative theistic case need not claim dominance on every finely divided datum. It can instead test whether one stable divine-reasons model improves likelihood across several independently motivated partitions without changing its auxiliary assumptions for each partition. If orderly laws, value-capable agents, embodiment, and consciousness receive support from the same purposive structure, that stability is evidentially relevant. By contrast, a naturalistic rival assembled from unrelated initial, psychophysical, and modal stipulations may incur cumulative specification costs even when each component is locally concise.

novelty.explanation: This newly proposes cross-partition auxiliary stability as a comparative indicator of genuine explanatory compression.

newArguments.title: Counterfactual value profile
newArguments.text: Theism can reduce anthropocentric tailoring by stating counterfactual expectations before focusing on humanity: worlds containing diverse finite agents, reliable causal order, opportunities for cooperation and harm, and localized powers should be more expected than worlds lacking every such good. The evidential target is then a value profile instantiated by many possible species and arrangements, not our exact biology. This approach remains conditional because perfect goodness may support competing creations, but it supplies a clearer comparison than merely observing that humans exist.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a species-neutral counterfactual value profile that was not explicitly developed in the transcript.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that naturalism blocks a theistic probability advantage when economical naturalistic models remain viable and the proposed theistic likelihood gains depend on unstable outcome descriptions or modal assumptions.

novelty.explanation: This integrates Oppy's separate undercutting moves into one disciplined comparative thesis.

premises.text: Posterior comparison requires rivals specified to equivalent depth, because comparing a flexible divine person with a narrowly parameterized physical model can distort both prior complexity and likelihood.

novelty.explanation: This develops the equal-detail requirement and explains why asymmetric elaboration biases comparison.

premises.text: A naturalistic disposition counts as economical only when its governing structure is independently concise and generates later complexity without encoding each law, organism, or mental outcome separately.

novelty.explanation: This answers the hidden-specificity objection by imposing an explicit generative compression condition.

premises.text: Likelihood claims must identify outcome classes independently of observation and compare them with alternative valuable creations, preventing post hoc selection of humans or embodied agents as the uniquely intended result.

novelty.explanation: This formalizes the transcript's anthropocentric challenge as an independently specified selection control.

premises.text: Naturalism may compare physical identity and emergent nonphysicalist models as alternatives, but each must specify its explanatory principles and associated complexity before either supports a probability judgment.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens naturalistic pluralism while preventing mere availability from substituting for explanatory adequacy.

premises.text: Necessity claims should rest on a positive account of reality's modal structure rather than conceivability, ignorance, or an unexplained entity's foundational position.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the ontological insight while repairing reliance on an insufficiently defended actualist restriction.

conclusion.text: Therefore, unless theism demonstrates robust prior or likelihood superiority under equal detail, independent outcome classes, and defensible modality, economical naturalistic alternatives prevent a warranted comparative probability advantage.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately denies an established advantage rather than claiming that naturalism is conclusively demonstrated.

newArguments.title: Predictive flexibility penalty
newArguments.text: A personal explanation can accommodate many outcomes by appealing to different possible reasons, but that flexibility may reduce predictive concentration. The comparison should therefore ask how much probability the divine model assigns to the observed broad outcome class before specifying which goods the world realizes. If order, disorder, embodied life, disembodied life, abundance, scarcity, suffering, and their opposites can each receive an available divine rationale, purposive explanation may fit retrospectively without producing a strong likelihood. Naturalistic models should face the same penalty when adjustable dispositions permit similarly broad accommodation.

novelty.explanation: This introduces a symmetric flexibility penalty for theories capable of accommodating many contrary outcomes.

newArguments.title: Naturalistic model ensemble
newArguments.text: Comparative assessment should distinguish one elaborated naturalistic model from the broader naturalistic family. A weak toy model does not exhaust naturalism, yet summing over many models cannot be free because prior weight must be distributed among them. An explicit ensemble treatment can capture both facts: multiple independently motivated physical or psychophysical models may collectively predict the evidence, while highly adjustable or redundant variants receive smaller individual weight. This provides a principled alternative to treating either one schematic singularity or an unrestricted naturalistic disjunction as the sole rival.

novelty.explanation: This newly introduces model averaging to balance naturalistic diversity against the complexity cost of unrestricted disjunction.
